Kandagiri Spinning Mills demonstrates a significant capacity for operational efficiency, evidenced by a robust ROE of 19.55% which substantially outperforms the sector benchmark of 6.53% [E8]. The company has successfully optimized its working capital cycle, with debtor days showing a marked improvement from 296 to 119 days [E36]. Despite broader challenges, the firm generated positive operating cash flow of Rs 0.30 Cr and free cash flow of Rs 0.37 Cr in March 2025 [E26, E27]. Market confidence is reflected in the stock's strong medium-term performance, with a 50% compounded share price growth over the last three years [E19]. Furthermore, the company is showing signs of fundamental recovery, as recent profit growth has begun to outpace one-year price growth by 19% [E34]. Conceded: the company faces significant headwinds including a negative ROCE [E9, E11], a concerning current ratio of 0.28x [E28], and a multi-year decline in compounded sales growth [E12, E38].
